items.title: Citi opens downside catalyst watch on Kroger as Walmart price war intensifies
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi has opened a short-term downside catalyst watch on Kroger (NYSE: KR) ahead of second-quarter results on Sept. 11, warning that intensifying price competition from Walmart could pressure the grocer's comparable sales and margins.

items.title: Kroger shares fall 1.2% after Citi issues short-term downside watch
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) shares fell 1. 2% in pre-market trading after Citi placed the supermarket group on a short-term downside Catalyst Watch ahead of its second-quarter 2026 earnings report.

items.title: Kroger amplifies wellness focus with in-store events and ‘mini-fests’
items.summary: The grocery company plans to host activities at participating stores throughout September.

items.title: Costco Stock's Premium Rests On A Visit Rate That Keeps Slowing
items.summary: The comp still looks strong, but the part of it that comes from members actually walking in has more than halved in a year, and that visit rate is what a growth-stock multiple on a warehouse retailer is really underwriting.

items.title: Dollar stores grow sales as grocers grapple with weak results
items.summary: Dollar General and Dollar Tree both recorded comparable-store sales increases of more than 3% during their latest quarters.

items.title: Kroger (KR) Stock Declines While Market Improves: Some Information for Investors
items.summary: The latest trading day saw Kroger (KR) settling at $56.93, representing a -2.7% change from its previous close.

items.title: What Could Lift Walmart Stock Is Not On Its Shelves
items.summary: The retailer keeps cutting shelf prices, and profit is growing far faster than the U.S. comp, with almost half of that growth coming from areas like advertising, marketplace, and membership.
